serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
What Big Daddy said…
Could it really be that I have mistaken a disabled person with a lot of prosthetics for a bot?
I thought that living with {f_botName} gave me enough expertise to discern the two from each other, but it seems like I was mistaken…
Should I trust my gut or believe in what Big Daddy said?
The things he found could be just an elaborate cover-up, right?
With all due respect to Big Daddy, I can’t listen to his advice this time. I just can’t! 
I know I’m right, I just need to find a way to prove it…
